description: Canonical conformance corpus: hand-written structural edge cases + real ground-truth architectures (reconciled verdict + per-node golden shapes). Edit gen_corpus.py / the ground-truth dumps; copies are byte-identical (check_validation_spec_sync.py).

cases.name: lenet5-valid
cases.description: Real LeNet-5 calibration graph (e2e/models/01_lenet5.py). Fully connected input->...->output; both validators agree it is valid with no diagnostics.

cases.name: lenet5-dangling-edge
cases.description: LeNet-5 with an extra edge referencing a non-existent target node. Both validators emit the per-edge dangling_edge rule (and nothing else).

cases.name: lenet5-ambiguous-fan-in
cases.description: LeNet-5 with a duplicated r1->p1 edge: two incoming connections on p1 input handle, no cycle. Both validators emit the per-node ambiguous_fan_in rule.

cases.name: broken-io-path-disconnected-output
cases.description: Severed graph using real LeNet node configs: input->c1 dead-ends, and the output node (no incoming, one outgoing to a dead-end d1) is disconnected from the input. Exercises the full G013 connectivity contract: both validators emit no_input_output_path plus per-node disconnected_node (output) and dead_end_node (c1 and d1) with an identical sorted multiset.

cases.name: cyclic-circular-dependency
cases.description: G018(a). A graph with a valid inp->c1->r1->out path plus a back-edge r1->c1 (on a distinct 'loopback' target handle so it does not trip ambiguous_fan_in) forming a c1->r1->c1 cycle. Canonical normalized verdict (see validation-spec.json edge_case_verdicts): a single graph-level CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY. The backend (Task D2) wires detect_cycles into validate_architecture to match the frontend, which already emits it.

cases.name: empty-architecture
cases.description: G018(b). An empty graph (no nodes, no edges). Canonical normalized verdict: a single graph-level EMPTY_ARCHITECTURE. The backend emits it from layer_config; the frontend (Task D3) drops its zero-node early-return-valid so it emits EMPTY_ARCHITECTURE too.

cases.name: missing-input-headless-compute
cases.description: G018(c). A graph with no input/dataset node: a headless dense compute node d1 feeds the output. Canonical normalized verdict (frontend cardinality wins): the headless compute node has no incoming connection (per-node DISCONNECTED_NODE) AND the architecture has no input layer (graph-level MISSING_INPUT). The backend (Task D2) aligns up by emitting the per-node DISCONNECTED_NODE for headless compute nodes alongside MISSING_INPUT.

cases.name: fully-isolated-node
cases.description: G018(d). An otherwise valid inp->c1->out path plus a fully-isolated dense node 'iso' (no incoming AND no outgoing edge). Canonical normalized verdict (backend single-emission cardinality wins): exactly one DISCONNECTED_NODE (no incoming) plus one DEAD_END_NODE (no outgoing) for the isolated node. The frontend (Task D3) aligns down by dropping its redundant 'isolated node' emission, which otherwise double-counts DISCONNECTED_NODE.

cases.name: realfixture-01-lenet5
cases.description: Real e2e architecture 01-lenet5 (ground-truth). Reconciled verdict + per-node golden shapes.

block_definitions.name: SE Block
block_definitions.description: Squeeze-and-Excitation block that recalibrates channel-wise feature responses using global average pooling and a gating mechanism.

block_definitions.name: FFN Block
block_definitions.description: Feed-forward network with SwiGLU activation and dropout. Standard sub-layer in Transformer architectures.

block_definitions.name: Transformer Encoder Block
block_definitions.description: Standard Transformer encoder layer with multi-head self-attention, FFN sub-layer, layer normalization, and residual connections.

block_definitions.name: Transformer Decoder Block
block_definitions.description: Transformer decoder layer with causal self-attention, cross-attention over encoder output, FFN, and three residual connections.

block_definitions.name: U-Net Down Block
block_definitions.description: Downsampling block with two Conv2d-BatchNorm-ReLU stages followed by max pooling. Used in the encoder path of U-Net architectures.

block_definitions.name: U-Net Mid Block
block_definitions.description: Bottleneck block with two Conv2d-BatchNorm-ReLU stages and optional cross-attention. Sits between the encoder and decoder paths.

block_definitions.name: U-Net Up Block
block_definitions.description: Upsampling block with transposed convolution, skip connection concatenation, and two Conv2d-BatchNorm-ReLU stages. Used in the decoder path of U-Net.

block_definitions.name: Audio Encoder Block
block_definitions.description: Three-layer 1D convolutional encoder with ReLU and batch normalization, followed by global average pooling. Designed for audio feature extraction.
